items.source: Update inspected information based on the provided bytes.
items.translation: 根据提供的字节更新检查信息。

items.source: len - the number of bytes to use, starting at offset.
items.translation: len - 要使用的字节数，从 offset 开始。

items.source: offset - the offset to start from in the array of bytes.
items.translation: offset - 在字节数组中开始读取的偏移量。

items.source: Interface that can be used to inspect content as it is initially read.
items.translation: 可用于在初始读取时检查内容的接口。

items.source: IOException - on IO error
items.translation: IOException - 在 IO 错误时
